business.name: Good Intentions
business.description: One-of-one vintage and secondhand clothing, themed collections, style bundles, personal styling, and community-rooted good vibes.

brand.visualDirection: A dark plum editorial foundation with warm cream type, saturated pink-orange-purple gradients, glowing circular motifs, and enough restraint for each collection to introduce its own mood.

commerce.localPickup: Not offered for normal website orders. Prearranged handoff may happen at in-person events.
commerce.inventoryModel: Most clothing is assumed to be one-of-one until Sage confirms otherwise.
commerce.developmentNotice: The catalog and prices below are foundation examples based on supplied Instagram references. Checkout remains disabled until real inventory, measurements, policies, and payment links are approved.

collections.name: Shakira Collection
collections.description: Y2K performance energy, metallic details, statement belts, skirts, and bold going-out pieces.

collections.name: A Midsummer Night's Dream
collections.description: Earthy fairy energy, ethereal layers, floral texture, lace, and dreamy color.

collections.name: Zara Larsson Collection
collections.description: Bright pop-star styling, saturated Y2K color, playful silhouettes, and statement pieces.

collections.name: Whimsigoth Collection
collections.description: Celestial color, flowing layers, witchy texture, and romantic alternative styling.

styleBundles.summary: Personalized secondhand pieces selected through direct communication with Sage.
process: Message Sage and describe the look, sizes, measurements, budget, inspiration, likes, dislikes, and goals.
Sage confirms the bundle scope, current price, timing, and availability directly.
Sage curates the pieces and communicates any needed decisions.
The completed bundle ships within the United States or may be handed over at a prearranged in-person event.

personalStyling.summary: Personal styling is arranged through direct communication rather than a fixed package.

donations.summary: Potential donors send photos first. Sage accepts or declines the items before shipping or meetup.
donations.compensation: Donors do not normally receive payment, credit, or another benefit.

events.summary: Good Intentions frequently attends vintage markets, pop-ups, and community events in New York and nearby areas.

policies.shipping: Orders placed through the website will ship within the United States.
policies.returns: A final return and exchange policy must be approved before checkout is enabled.
policies.oneOfOne: An item is not reserved until payment is completed. Most pieces are expected to have a quantity of one.
policies.condition: Secondhand items may show normal signs of wear. Known flaws should be photographed and described in the listing.
policies.customServices: Style bundles and personal styling are arranged directly. Scope, price, turnaround, and cancellation terms must be confirmed before payment.
policies.donations: Sending photographs does not guarantee acceptance. Do not ship or bring items until Sage confirms acceptance and a handoff method.
